patch_description: This version crossovers the stronger parts of the prior feature sets while biasing more heavily toward regime-invariant, short-horizon signals. It keeps the feature count under 80, emphasizes rolling z-scores, short lookbacks, volatility/efficiency/autocorrelation change features, and a few robust interactions like momentum × volatility regime. The XGBoost settings are slightly more expressive than the current program but still constrained to avoid overfitting and prediction collapse.
